reason: 23 implemented GTM and workflow utilities, but destination unlink is an exposed unsupported action and session removal description overstates Google auth revocation.
exposure: All 23 schemas returned unconditionally by registerAllTools; container create/update/remove and version publish/remove are absent from advertised enums and explicitly rejected by handlers.
limitations: Offline evaluation of checked-in compiled schema modules only; no MCP protocol session or authenticated API operations executed.
Destination unlink is in registered action enum but always throws unsupported-operation error.
gtm_remove_session clears local state and caches rather than remotely revoking Google authorization.

Workspace export only issues one list request per resource (no nextPageToken loop), omits gtag_config resources, and suppresses errors for optional clients/zones/transformations, so its COMPLETE promise is not guaranteed.
Most configuration payloads are intentionally unrestricted objects in upstream schemas; no imagined Google API fields were added.

tools.name: gtm_context
tools.description:
GTM 작업 환경(컨텍스트)을 관리합니다. 한 번 설정하면 이후 모든 도구 호출에서 accountId/containerId/workspaceId를 생략할 수 있습니다.

**권장 워크플로우:**
1. gtm_context action='set' → Account/Container/Workspace 선택
2. 이후 gtm_tag, gtm_trigger 등 호출 시 ID 생략 가능

**액션:**
- 'get': 현재 설정된 컨텍스트 조회
- 'set': 컨텍스트 설정 (accountId 필수, containerId/workspaceId 선택)
- 'clear': 컨텍스트 초기화

action.description: get: 현재 컨텍스트 조회, set: 컨텍스트 설정, clear: 컨텍스트 초기화

accountId.description: GTM Account ID. 'set' action에서 필수.

workspaceId.description: GTM Workspace ID. 'set' action에서 선택. containerId가 있어야 설정 가능.

tools.behavior: Reads, clears or sets session hierarchy context; setting verifies names through GTM account/container/workspace reads.

tools.name: gtm_workflow
tools.description:
Executes GTM Agent System workflows for tag replication between workspaces.

Actions:
- analyze: Analyze source workspace tags and build dependency graph
- replicate: Replicate tags from source to target workspace (full workflow)
- status: Get current workflow status

This tool uses the multi-agent system (AnalyzerAgent, NamingAgent, PlannerAgent, BuilderAgent, ValidatorAgent) to automatically:
1. Analyze dependencies between tags, triggers, variables
2. Apply naming patterns from target workspace
3. Plan creation order respecting dependencies
4. Create entities in correct order
5. Validate created entities

action.description: The workflow action to perform

sessionId.description: Unique session ID for tracking workflow state. Required for all actions.

sourceAccountId.description: Source GTM Account ID. Required for 'analyze' and 'replicate' actions.

sourceContainerId.description: Source GTM Container ID. Required for 'analyze' and 'replicate' actions.

sourceWorkspaceId.description: Source GTM Workspace ID. Required for 'analyze' and 'replicate' actions.

targetAccountId.description: Target GTM Account ID. Required for 'replicate' action.

targetContainerId.description: Target GTM Container ID. Required for 'replicate' action.

targetWorkspaceId.description: Target GTM Workspace ID. Required for 'replicate' action.

tagIds.description: Comma-separated list of tag IDs to analyze/replicate (e.g., '123,456,789'). Required for 'analyze' and 'replicate' actions.

includeAllDependencies.description: Whether to include all dependencies (triggers, variables, templates). Default: true

skipNaming.description: Skip naming pattern analysis. Default: false

skipValidation.description: Skip validation after creation. Default: false

dryRun.description: If true, only plan without creating. Default: false

namePrefix.description: Prefix to add to entity names (e.g., '[COPY] ')

nameSuffix.description: Suffix to add to entity names (e.g., ' v2')

tools.behavior: Runs local multi-agent tag dependency analysis or replication using internal tag/trigger/variable/template handlers, and reports session workflow status.

review.summary: Manage server clients and transformations, export workspace resources, and prepare tracking workflow changes.
